# Alignment Files

This project included a fine-scale look at the molecular phylogenetics of Asterophryinae microhylid frogs. We provide multiple sequence alignment files for datasets focusing on all samples.

**Alns_MAFFT.zip**/**Alns_MAFFT_Summary**: Fully sampled multiple sequence alignments generated by MAFFT. The summary directory holds information on sequence statistics by locus and by taxon.

**Alns_MACSE.zip**: Fully sampled multiple sequence alignments generated by MAFFT and refined using MACSE.
